inTheSaucer.say: Grey: Oh crap. Oh crap, man, the human is awake!
Other grey: Why is it doing the eyes? I hate when they do the eyes.
Grey: Put him back under till we get back! No, the OTHER button. The one that isn't the radio.
Saucer radio: ...smooth jazz, all night long...
Narrator: Some time later. Exactly how much later is classified above the President's pay grade.

inThePines.say: Grey: Hey. Hey, man. You gotta wake up.
Other grey: Sorry about the abduction. Genuinely. There was a mix-up with the paperwork.
Grey: But you've got bigger problems now.
Other grey: Do what this thing says, or your whole race is toast. That's not a threat. We like toast.
Grey: There are bad, bad, BAD forces at play, man. Coming this way. That's three bads. We don't use three bads lightly.
Voice from the saucer: Zib! Norb! The meter's running and we are double-parked over a national forest!
You: ...Gary is going to be so mad he slept through this.
